patch_description: Fix the convex hull to a reference triangle and constrain the remaining ten points to its interior. This removes hull-area recomputation and eliminates wasted search effort on affine-equivalent hull deformations; determinant magnitudes are then exactly the evaluator’s normalized triangle areas. The faster, geometrically normalized objective is paired with a deterministic final active-set stencil polish: it identifies vertices participating in the current lower-tail triangles and probes axis, diagonal, and radial perturbations while accepting only strict bottleneck improvements.
